name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; 'slide_panel_step' = one panel slide-animation frame, 'bottom' = bottom panel, 'main' = the wide panel (vs the 'small' narrow strip). Consistent with siblings fd2_slide_panel_step_{top,bottom}_small and fd2_slide_panel_step_{left,right}_main. No address residue; descriptor accurately reflects the function (bottom wide panel single slide step).
purpose: Render one slide-animation frame of the bottom wide (0xAA-byte) 'main' panel for the Party Status Overview screen, rising up from below to settle at y=0x9B.
logic_summary: row_count defaults to 0x10. For frame_idx<5 returns (other panels not yet placed). For frame_idx>9 the panel sits settled at dst_y=0x9B. For frames 5..9, y_shift=(4-(frame_idx-5))*9 (frame5=36,6=27,...,9=0) and dst_y=y_shift+0x9B descends toward 0x9B; if dst_y+0x10>200 the panel runs off the screen bottom so row_count=dst_y-200 (only triggers at frame 5, where the value is non-positive and the copy loop draws nothing). src row-0 = src_buffer+0xC20B; dst byte offset = dst_y*0x140+0x4B. Loop copies row_count rows (each memmove 0xAA bytes) into data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr, advancing both src and dst by one 320-byte scanline (0x140) per row.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Source panel composite buffer (the malloc'd panel_buf the caller filled via fd2_render_party_status_overview_content). The bottom-main panel's row-0 source data lives at src_buffer + 0xC20B.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_1; src already uses the accurate name src_buffer. Stage 2 should rename Ghidra param to match. No address residue in the proposed name.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Animation frame index (0..0xB) driven by the caller's intro (0->0xB) / outro (0xB->0) loops; gates whether/where the panel is drawn this frame.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_2; src already uses the accurate name frame_idx. Stage 2 should rename Ghidra param to match. No address residue in the proposed name.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is the row-blit into data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr.

comment_original_issue: Source comment was a single terse line ('Bottom main panel slide-in from below (0xAA-wide, 0x10 rows).') that omitted the settle position (y=0x9B), the frame gating (<5 skip, 5..9 slide, >=10 settled), and the first-frame bottom-edge clip, falling short of the sibling panel-step comments.
notes: Single caller fd2_open_party_status_overview_screen (2 call sites: intro frame loop @0001b2be, outro frame loop @0001b3bf). One of four per-frame sibling steps (right_main / top_small / bottom_main / bottom_small). src is a faithful, slightly cleaner rendering of the decomp: src writes the bottom-clip as row_count=dst_y-200 while the raw decomp/plate use the algebraically-equal y_offset-0x2D (both equal y_shift-0x2D); plate left unchanged as it is accurate and consistent. No logic discrepancy found; no issues filed.
